commands.name: typecheck (ratchet)
commands._note: NOT `tsc -b`. Nothing had ever typechecked this repo — `build` is a bare `vite build` — and the first run found 2,183 errors. The ratchet holds that number from growing; see scripts/typecheck-baseline.mjs and typecheck-baseline.json. Wiring tsc into `build` today would fail every Vercel deploy.

commands.name: build (vite build — does NOT typecheck)
commands._note: Kept as a bare vite build deliberately. The typecheck step above is what covers types, at a baseline, until the debt is paid down.
